public_body: Old Kings Highway Historic District Commission
overall: The AG found the Commission did not convene in executive session on November 28, 2023, so no executive-session violation. Remaining allegations (executive session purpose/topics, minutes accuracy) were untimely and declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to follow proper procedures for convening in executive session at its November 28, 2023 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Commission did not convene in executive session on November 28, 2023, and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law by improperly convening in executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission improperly met in executive session on November 28, 2023, the part of the meeting said to be outside public view.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the remaining allegations in the complaint were not timely raised, and we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission discussed improper topics in executive session during the November 28, 2023 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the remaining allegations in the complaint were not timely raised, and we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the amended minutes of the November 28, 2023 meeting were inaccurate because they omit a summary of the brief end-of-meeting discussion.
allegations.key_passage: an allegation regarding the omission of a summary of the alleged non-public portion of the meeting should have been raised in a complaint filed no later than 30 days after initial approval of the minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission improperly excluded her attorney and others from the open meeting when the chair asked people talking to take the discussion into the hall.
allegations.key_passage: the Commission did not improperly exclude the Complainant, her attorney, or other individuals from the meeting.
